answer: Streak multipliers at the kernel: each identity's payout scales with consecutive verified epochs, capping at 8x after 30 epochs. A thread of fresh sybils starts at 1x, so farming n identities yields n payouts while an honest streak yields 8n from one. The meadow of stale accounts decays 20% per missed epoch, forcing attackers to sustain costly parallel activity. Splitting stake across identities forfeits compounding; merging defeats the purpose. Works because linear sybil cost meets exponential honest reward.
